item.title: FeedFlo - Full Stack Developer - Co-op
item.description:
FeedFlo provides sensors that monitor animal feed pipes to keep farmers informed about their barns and ensure any issues are discovered and addressed quickly to keep the animals healthy.

My primay roles at FeedFlo were to create and improve features for the web front-end and create a mobile app equivalent to the web front-end. Since I had no prior experience in web or mobile development, I was required to learn a lot and learn it quickly. I developed a strong understanding of JavaScript and React as I worked independently on, and took ownership of, several features for their web front-end’s alert dashboard including adding date-based paging, URL embedded filters for easy copying, and clickable graph elements. I built my understanding of mobile software development while working to build the foundation for FeedFlo’s mobile app. I also built skills with Git, GitHub, and SQL throughout my time at FeedFlo.
